Bent over a spread of star-charts with one finger pressed to a constellation, lips moving silently.
Dipping a quill into a squat ink-pot, wrist cocked and waiting, the open logbook half-filled with cramped script.
Kneeling before the hearth with a small iron poker, nudging a stubborn log deeper into the coals.
Cradling a clouded crystal orb in both palms, turning it slowly toward the amber lamplight to peer through its center.
Asleep at the writing desk with cheek resting on a folded arm, a burned-down candle guttered beside an unfinished letter.
Pulling a cork free from a tiny blue phial with careful fingers, nose already tilted toward the opening.
Cross-legged on the hearthrug with a heavy tome propped open across both knees, one thumb holding a dog-eared page.
Blowing a long, slow breath across the face of a dusty leather-bound atlas, motes drifting up through the lamplight.
Lifting a glass alembic from its iron stand and tilting it toward the candle, watching amber liquid inch toward the neck.
Scratching a drowsy pseudo-dragon under its jaw with two fingers while keeping both eyes fixed on a rune-covered tablet.
Pinching dried lavender and moonroot over the lip of the iron cauldron, letting the crumble fall one pinch at a time.
Curled sideways in a high-backed armchair with a knee drawn up, a small paperback grimoire tented over one shin.
Pressing a stick of black sealing wax against a candle flame, watching the first slow drip fall onto a folded letter.
Holding a brass astrolabe up to the skylight with one eye squinted, the other lost in shadow.
Sweeping a small broom in short strokes across the flagstones near the ash-lip of the hearth, cinders skittering ahead.
Threading a long leather lace through the spine-holes of a half-unbound grimoire, tongue pressed lightly to the corner of the mouth.
Tipping a ceramic bottle sideways over an oil lamp's reservoir, filling it drop by careful drop.
Cupping both hands around a chipped earthenware mug, eyes half-closed, chin dipped toward the steam rising off the surface.
Reaching one open palm toward a drifting wisp of light, fingers loose and patient, letting it come on its own.
Tracing a finger slowly along an inked sigil carved into a stone tablet, pausing at each junction of the design.
Crouching beside a low wooden shelf and coaxing a small book-imp out from behind a row of folios with gentle clicking sounds.
Unrolling a brittle parchment map across the table's edge and anchoring one corner under a smooth river-stone to keep it flat.
Perched on the stool beside the cold window, listening to the rain, a half-read letter loose between two fingers.
Holding a faceted amber stone up level with both eyes, tilting it left, then right, in the light of the brass lantern.
Stirring a small clay bowl of crushed herbs with the blunt end of a quill, the dry scent lifting sharply into the cool air.
